title: Finite-Sample Hausdorff Bounds and Hadamard Sensitivity for Regressions with MNAR Covariates
summary: Covariates missing not at random generally prevent point identification of regression coefficients without untestable restrictions. This paper studies linear regression when every missing covariate is restricted to a prespecified compact interval. The resulting population target is the set of best linear predictor coefficients compatible with the observed-data law. Under a non-atomic observed-data law and the stated regularity conditions, we can represent this identified set as the image, under the least-squares moment map, of the Aumann expectation of a random moment set.
